items.title: Nikmat yang Sering Kita Lupakan
paragraphs: Every morning, Farid opens the window in his room. He feels the cool air and sees the light outside. He can breathe, stand, and walk to the kitchen. These simple things are gifts from Allah. Farid often forgets them when he is busy.

One morning, his younger sister feels tired. She cannot go to school. Farid brings her water and calls their mother. While he waits, he thinks about his own health. He sees that good health is not something he made by himself. It is a mercy from Allah.

Farid thanks Allah for his eyes, hands, family, and safe home. He also decides to use these gifts in a good way. He helps his mother, speaks kindly to his sister, and does not waste food. His day is still busy, but his heart feels different.

A person can remember Allah through ordinary blessings. Clean water, warm food, family, and a healthy body are all reasons to be thankful. When Farid notices these gifts, he feels less proud and more ready to help others. Gratitude begins with seeing what Allah has already given.

items.title: Berdoa Hanya kepada Allah
paragraphs: Nadia has an important interview on Monday morning. She prepares her clothes, checks the address, and sets an alarm. She knows that preparation is important, so she does her part carefully. Still, she also knows that the final result is not fully in her hands.

Before leaving home, Nadia makes dua to Allah. She asks Allah to make the matter easy and to give her what is best. She does not ask a lucky object, a star, or another hidden power. She asks the One who created her and knows her situation completely.

At the interview, Nadia answers slowly and honestly. Some questions are easy, and some are difficult. She stays calm and does not pretend to know everything. After the interview, she leaves the result to Allah. She will be happy if she gets the job, but she will not lose hope if she does not.

Making dua does not mean leaving all work. Nadia prepares, travels, and speaks with care. Dua gives her a clear heart while she makes an effort. A Muslim asks Allah for help because all power belongs to Him. Then the Muslim accepts the result and continues to do what is right.

items.title: Mengucap Bismillah dengan Sadar
paragraphs: Before breakfast, Yusuf reaches for a piece of bread. His hand stops for a moment. He remembers to say Bismillah before he eats. These words are short, but they remind him that the food is a gift from Allah. The farmer, the shop worker, and his mother all helped bring it to the table.

Yusuf eats slowly and does not take more food than he needs. His little brother asks why he says Bismillah. Yusuf explains that a Muslim begins a good action by remembering Allah. The words do not make the meal complicated. They help the heart remember who gives blessings.

Later that day, Yusuf uses the same habit before opening his school book. He says Bismillah and starts his work. He also says it before helping his father carry a box. He learns that remembering Allah is not only for one place. It can guide many lawful actions during the day.

Bismillah is not a magic phrase. It is a statement of dependence on Allah. Yusuf still eats, studies, and works. The words help him begin with a better intention. When a person remembers Allah before an action, the action can become more careful and thankful.
